name: Formosan koa
desc: Formosan koa (Acacia confusa): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Acacia confusa is a perennial tree native to South-East Asia. Some common names for it are ayangile, small Philippine acacia, Formosa acacia, Philippine Wattle, and Formosan koa.
